prompt: A feature request requires changes to an unknown set of files. A lead agent reads the codebase, decides which files need work, and assigns each to a helper.
tells: decides which files need work, and assigns each
why: The subtasks depend on the input, so a lead plans and delegates them at run time.
trap: Parallelization runs subtasks fixed in advance; here the lead discovers them.

prompt: For a market report, a lead agent decides which competitors and topics to research based on the request, then dispatches a researcher for each and writes the synthesis.
tells: decides which competitors and topics to research based on the request
why: Dynamic decomposition plus delegation plus synthesis.
trap: A single agent loop could do it, but slowly and with one overloaded context.

prompt: A single agent auditing a huge codebase runs out of context halfway. Each module could be audited separately, but which modules matter depends on what's found.
tells: which modules matter depends on what's found
why: Workers each get a fresh context for one module; the orchestrator keeps the overview and decides what's next.
trap: Memory helps across sessions, not with one context being overloaded.

prompt: Plan a trip: a planner works out which flights, hotels and activities are needed for this traveler, then hands each search to a specialist agent and assembles the itinerary.
tells: works out which flights, hotels and activities are needed
hands each search to a specialist agent
why: The planner decomposes at run time and delegates; specialists report back.
trap: Routing picks one handler per request; here one request becomes many subtasks.
